contract_inferred: No 00-contract.md. Inferred from the page: web, Persuade (the landing page of a career-guidance tool whose 'Build my roadmap' starts an app flow), English only (html lang en at every width), a European audience across several countries ('Career guidance for Europe', salaries 'matched to that country', the example in Poland with 'PLN 9,000–15,000 / month'). No right-to-left language is named.
overall_reason: The layout is built for real content (logical properties, wrap-anywhere rules, dvh heights, currency codes per country), but the landing page is rendered by script and shows no text at all with scripts off.

score.reason: T-NO-SCRIPT fails completely on a landing page (ROB-015, citing the sweep's ROB-001 Floor), while T-WIDTHS, T-HOSTILE-CONTENT, T-LOCALE-FORMAT and T-WEIGHT-FOR-JOB pass.

findings.title: Content and navigation do not depend on script
findings.where: Whole page (React single-page app, assets/index-Cc41x9iY.js with react, supabase and motion chunks), all widths
findings.evidence: With scripts off the page has 0 visible and 0 total characters against 1,489 in the baseline (resilience.hidden_content.scripts_off; scripts_off_note 'no text at all with scripts off'). The sweep's hidden_content hit (ROB-001, Floor) records the same 100%. The headline, the four steps, the example match, the navigation and the footer links (Privacy Policy, Terms, Legal) all need the 109 KiB app script.
findings.before: The marketing route and the legal links are rendered by the same client app as the roadmap tool.
findings.after: Prerender the landing, legal and contact routes to static HTML; keep the roadmap builder as the script-driven part.
findings.why: A visitor or crawler without script sees a blank page, including the privacy and legal pages a European audience may need to reach.
findings.root: Client-only rendering of the marketing routes

strengths: The stylesheet uses logical properties almost as often as physical ones (121 logical against 126 physical, 34 start and end rules, 5 dir rules), a head start for any right-to-left market.
Long strings have wrap rules in the stylesheet (.wrap-anywhere, .wrap-break-word), and 17 min-width: 0 rules keep flex text from forcing overflow.
Salaries carry a currency code and a period ('PLN 9,000–15,000 / month'), so the figure stays unambiguous across the European countries the page serves.
Headings and step texts wrap at 375 without clipping (tiles/375-00.png to tiles/375-03.png); the header collapses to a menu button and a theme toggle at 375.
The page weighs 339 KiB over 11 requests, with an LCP of 552 ms in the lab, inside every budget; heights use dvh or svh in 7 rules against 1 vh.
not_investigated: T-STRESS: no hostile content was injected; long career names and degree names were judged from layout evidence.
A right-to-left render and translated strings were not captured.
The page load was not throttled and layout shift was not measured as a number (capture predates the CLS record).
T-FAILURE-PATH and T-SLOW-LINE: async found no primary actions; the roadmap builder and its result page were not opened.
T-EXTREME-COUNTS: the only counts are the example's salary and match figures, which are labelled as an example.
One stylesheet was cross-origin and unreadable; its rules are unknown, not absent.
Capture prep clicked 'Essential only' on the cookie banner at every width.
Widths between the captures, landscape, zoom at 200%, back navigation and deep links.
